objective: Fix Marites compact preview photo failures: pass durable private Storage paths into signed-media cache and Full View with no changed permissions
productionBaselineEvidence: Latest published BUKLOD main 59e4c1dff5200eec72a37ec065ecacbc23f0fe99; current Marites loader, collage, and media signer inspected. No schema/native/permission modifications.
chosenApproach: Keep photo URL and corresponding private media path aligned in all collage tiles and Full View. Existing bounded private signed-URL cache can re-sign after expiry without changing audience rules.
selectionRationale: Marites collage discarded photo_paths; the shared image component cannot renew failed signed URLs without them. Fresh Full View sometimes reloaded the same stored image, matching screenshot.
acceptanceChecks: Single/multi Marites previews carry corresponding stable Storage path
Expired signed URL can recover through existing bounded signing/retry
Local story photos without storage paths continue rendering
No ad, PTT, QMP, upload, Finance, or native changes
Exact-source Node, TypeScript, Android and Web QA before promotion; no device success assertion
